name: chipvoice
description: Game audio on a real NES sound chip. A Ricoh 2A03 emulated at the clock level, in an AudioWorklet or rendered offline to a file, with sound effects that steal channels from the music - the way the hardware did.
author: Gwendall Esnault (https://gwendall.com)

scripts.dev: npm run worklet && (npm run worklet -- --watch & tsc -p tsconfig.build.json --watch)
scripts.test:unit: node test/validate.mjs && node test/clock.mjs && node test/driver.mjs && node test/vgm.mjs && node test/golden.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:fresh
